name: temporal-ordering
description: Tests time-dependent relevance. Memories have explicit timestamps (via `seeds`), and recall must return all entries regardless of age. Tests that the temporal pipeline preserves and surfaces both recent and historical information.

Docker build and push to ECR (2026-05-15)
